newsitem.title: USA: Double Day sees meeting 1997 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Double Day sees meeting 1997 forecast.

text.p: Double Day Inc said it is on track to meet its forecast of between $0.35 and $0.40 per share for the year.
"We hit our earnings target in the first quarter and expect to continue on track during the rest of the year," President and Chief Executive George Lodick said in a statement.
The company said its growth in 1997 will be fueled by a variety of factors, including:
-- Increased production at its Warren, Ohio, recycling center
-- A waste coal fines briquetting plant under construction in Sugar Creek, Ohio, which is scheduled to go into production in the third quarter.
-- A waste coal fines remediation plant under construction at the Mon View Mine in New Eagle, Pa. which is scheduled to go on line June 2.
